test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for the blank in the sentence below. 

Despite being wealthy, Rohan couldn't resist stealing small items from stores, suggesting he might be a _____
solution: The correct answer is: **Kleptomaniac**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Kleptomaniac"** refers to a person who has an uncontrollable urge to steal, even when they have no need for what they steal. (चोरी की आदत वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** Despite his wealth, his kleptomania led him to steal trivial items from the store. • In the given sentence, Rohan's behavior of stealing small items despite being wealthy suggests that he might be a kleptomaniac. (चोरी करने की आदत वाले व्यक्ति के रूप में संदर्भित) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Kleptomaniac**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Philanthropist** (परोपकारी): A person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by donating money or resources to charitable causes. • **Example:** The philanthropist donated millions of dollars to build schools in underprivileged areas. • **Pessimist** (निराशावादी): A person who tends to see the worst aspect of things or believes that the worst will happen. • **Example:** The pessimist always expects bad outcomes, even in favorable situations. • **Hypochondriac** (स्वास्थ्य संबंधी चिंता से ग्रस्त व्यक्ति): A person who is abnormally anxious about their health and constantly believes they are ill. • **Example:** The hypochondriac visited the doctor multiple times a week, convinced he had a serious illness. 14d:T9fe, The correct answer is: **Hypocrisy**.
